# RSC Publishing

> > The Royal Society of Chemistry's premier publishing platform, hosting current high-impact journals in chemistry, materials science, energy, and environmental research, alongside extensive historical archives.

RSC Publishing (pubs.rsc.org) serves as the digital home for the Royal Society of Chemistry's portfolio of peer-reviewed scientific journals, spanning cutting-edge research in organic chemistry, materials science, energy systems, and environmental technology. The platform maintains both active journals with rapid peer review times and comprehensive archives of historical publications dating back to the 1960s.

## Key Topics

- Royal Society of Chemistry
- peer-reviewed chemistry journals
- materials science
- environmental science
- organic chemistry
- inorganic chemistry
- energy research
- chemical communications
- Journal of the Chemical Society
- impact factor metrics
- academic publishing
- historical chemical archives
- soft matter research
- biomolecular chemistry

## Current Active Journals

- [Energy & Environmental Science](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/ee): Flagship journal (IF: 31) for agenda-setting research on energy provision and environmental protection, edited by Jenny Nelson
- [Materials Chemistry Frontiers](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/qm): High-quality multidisciplinary materials science research (IF: 6.4, CiteScore: 12.0), edited by Shu-Hong Yu
- [Journal of Materials Chemistry C](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/tc): Materials for optical, magnetic and electronic devices (IF: 5.2), edited by Martyn McLachlan
- [Dalton Transactions](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/dt): International journal for inorganic and organometallic chemistry (IF: 3.3), MEDLINE-indexed, 23-day review time
- [Organic & Biomolecular Chemistry](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/ob): Organic synthesis, supramolecular chemistry, and chemical biology (IF: 2.8), edited by Anthony Davis
- [Soft Matter](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/sm): Interdisciplinary journal for innovative soft matter research and reviews (IF: 2.8), edited by Alfred Crosby
- [Environmental Science: Water Research & Technology](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/ew): Innovation for sustainable water research (IF: 3.1), edited by Graham Gagnon

## Historical Journal Archives

- [Journal of the Chemical Society, Chemical Communications](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/c3): Archive of Chemical Communications published 1972-1995
- [Chemical Communications (London)](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/c1): Early Chemical Communications archive from 1965-1968
- [Faraday Discussions of the Chemical Society](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/dc): Archive from 1972-1991, continued as Faraday Discussions in 1992
- [Journal of the Chemical Society, Faraday Transactions 1](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/f1): Physical chemistry in condensed phases archive (1972-1989)
- [Journal of the Chemical Society, Faraday Transactions 2](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/f2): Molecular and chemical physics archive (1972-1989)
- [Journal of the Chemical Society B: Physical Organic](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/j2): Physical organic chemistry archive published 1966-1971
- [Annual Reports Section "B" (Organic Chemistry)](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/oc): Annual reviews of organic and bioorganic chemistry research (1967-2013)

## Library Resources

- [RSC Publishing Librarian Newsletters](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/data/librarian-newsletters): Newsletters and resources for librarians and library professionals

## Optional

- [Metallomics](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/mt): Journal transitioned to Oxford University Press from January 2021
- [Analytical Communications](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/ac): Historical analytical chemistry journal archive (1996-1999)
- [Russian Chemical Reviews](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/rc): Reviews of important chemistry work from the former Soviet Union
- [Proceedings of the Society for Analytical Chemistry](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/journals/journalissues/sa): Historical proceedings archive from RSC Journals Archive
